<?php
class O {
    public function __toString(): string { echo "T;"; return "s"; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "D;"; }
}
function &f(): string {
    $x = new O;
    return $x;
}
f(); echo "A;";

<?php
class O {
    public function __toString(): string { echo "T;"; return "s"; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "D;"; }
}
function &f(): string {
    $x = new O;
    return $x;
}
$r =& f(); echo "R:",$r,";"; $r="changed"; echo "A:",$r,";";

<?php
class O {
    public function __toString(): string { echo "T;"; return "s"; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "D;"; }
}
function &f(): string {
    $x = new O;
    try { return $x; } finally { echo "F;"; }
}
f(); echo "A;";

<?php
class O {
    public function __toString(): string { echo "T;"; throw new Exception("callback"); }
    public function __destruct() { echo "D;"; }
}
function &f(): string {
    $x = new O;
    try { return $x; } finally { echo "F;"; }
}
try { $r =& f(); echo "BAD;"; }
catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo "C:",$e->getMessage(),";";
    $p = $e->getPrevious();
    echo $p === null ? "P:none;" : "P:".$p->getMessage().";";
}
echo "A;";
